name: io.github.apache/drill-mcp
title: Apache Drill
description: Query Apache Drill and explore its schemas, tables, columns, storage plugins, and cluster state. Writes are denied unless explicitly allowlisted.

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Backend to talk to Drill with: rest (default) or jdbc. The jdbc backend requires the drill-mcp[jdbc] extra and a JVM.

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authentication mode: none (default), basic (Drill's HTTP form login), or kerberos (SPNEGO, requires the drill-mcp[kerberos] extra).

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_USER
environmentVariables.description: Username, required when DRILL_AUTH is basic.

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password, required when DRILL_AUTH is basic.

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum rows returned by a single query. A caller may request fewer but never more.

environmentVariables.name: DRILL_JDBC_DRIVER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to drill-jdbc-all.jar. Required when DRILL_BACKEND is jdbc.
